headline: Approved a $98,278.64 invoice from Brown for investment services and a police sergeant's retirement request.
summary: The meeting included a presentation on the DAHAB August preliminary performance report. Members approved the August minutes, the $98,278.64 invoice from Brown for second quarter investment services, and the normal retirement request of Bret Ferrara, a Hamden Police Department sergeant, as of 9.18.2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 8.12, 2026 regular meeting, passed unanimously.
Approved the invoice from Brown for $98,278.64 for second quarter investment services, passed unanimously.
Approved normal retirement for Bret Ferrara, Sergeant of the Hamden Police Department, as of 9.18.2026, passed unanimously.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Retirement Board Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
3:00 PM, September 9, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 3:03 PM 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Chairman: Mayor Adam Sendroff. 
Board members: Henry G Dove, Brian Gilson, Bob Freeman, Joseph Colello, Christopher 
Rhone, Tim Mckeon. 
Interm H.R. Director: Lee palmer  
Pension Analist: Zelema Harris 
H.R. Administrative Assistant: J. Susy Diaz-Callands 
DAHAB Representative: Tom Doniham 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. 8.12, 2026 HERB Regular meeting minutes.  
  Regular August meeting minutes. 
Chairman Sendroff Motioned to approve the minutes. 
Board member Gilson seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 None. 
5. FINANCIAL   
 
 
 1. Presentation from DAHAB August preliminary performance report. 
       
  Presentation from DAHAB for the August preliminary performance report by Tom 
Donegan. 
  
6. ADMINISTRATIVE   
 
 
 1. Invoice from Brown in the total amount of $98,278.64 for 2nd Quarter Investment 
services from 4.01.2026 to 6.30.2026.
Chairman Adam Sendrof motioned to approve the invoice . 
Board member Tim McKeon seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
7. RETIREMEMENTS   
 
 
 1. Bret Ferrara, Sergeant of the Hamden Police Department, is requesting normal 
retirement as of 9.18.2026. 
       
  Chairperson Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
Board member Tim McKeon seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously.

 None.
